title: CO2 electroreduction (CO2RR) reference family
reaction: CO2 + n e- + n H+ -> products (CO, HCOO-, C2H4, C2H5OH, ...)
objective: Optional literature-backed electrocatalyst family for CO2-to-product electrolyzer cathodes. Candidates compare a Cu route biased toward multicarbon products (ethylene/ethanol) with an Au route optimized for CO selectivity and a Sn route optimized for formate, so the screening can reward different product targets and stack chemistries.

balanced.label: Balanced
balanced.description: Balance current stack economics, evidence quality, route maturity, and reported performance.

cost-first.label: Cost-first
cost-first.description: Bias ranking toward catalyst and electrode cost while preserving route and evidence guardrails.

evidence-first.label: Evidence-first
evidence-first.description: Reward stronger literature support and more reproducible CO2 electrolyzer cathode routes.

route_templates.name: Cu CO2RR cathode route
preprocess: Cu precursor or oxide-derived Cu staging
Conductive carbon or GDL substrate preparation
synthesis: Cu deposition or oxide-derived Cu reduction
Ink homogenization with PFSA or AEM ionomer
postprocess: CCM coating pass on the cathode side
quality_gates: Faradaic efficiency screen for C2 products
route_templates.route_note: Most transferable Cu CO2RR cathode basis covering oxide-derived and nanostructured copper variants targeting multicarbon products.

route_templates.name: Au CO-selective CO2RR route
route_templates.route_note: Au cathode route for CO-selective CO2RR, mature and highly selective but exposed to gold price.

route_templates.name: Sn formate-selective CO2RR route
route_templates.manufacturing_mode: Sn-based CO2RR cathode coating route (alkaline / AEM)
synthesis: Sn nanoparticle deposition or SnO2 reduction
route_templates.route_note: Sn-based formate-selective cathode in an alkaline / AEM stack, low catalyst-cost option when liquid formate is the target product.

candidates.title: Cu multicarbon CO2RR cathode
candidates.summary: Oxide-derived or nanostructured Cu cathode for CO2 electroreduction targeting ethylene / ethanol multicarbon products in a PEM-like or AEM-like stack.
decision_notes: Best fit when the program goal is multicarbon CO2 reduction (ethylene / ethanol) and a Cu cathode is acceptable.
Selectivity to C2 products improves with morphology control, but route maturity is lower than Au or Sn alternatives.

pricing.note: Live Cu feed with a precursor / conversion markup for oxide-derived or nanostructured Cu cathode screening.

candidates.title: Au CO-selective CO2RR cathode
candidates.summary: Au nanoparticle cathode optimized for CO-selective CO2 electroreduction in a PEM-like stack, used as the CO product anchor.
decision_notes: Use when high CO Faradaic efficiency is the program target and a precious-metal cathode is acceptable.
Catalyst economics are dominated by gold price exposure even at moderate loadings.

pricing.note: Live Au feed with a mild precursor / conversion markup for Au CO2RR cathode screening.

candidates.title: Sn formate CO2RR cathode
candidates.summary: Sn or SnO2-derived cathode for formate-selective CO2 electroreduction in an alkaline / AEM stack.
decision_notes: Use this when liquid formate is the target product and a non-noble cathode in an alkaline / AEM stack is acceptable.
Cathode economics stay favorable because Sn avoids PGM exposure, but stack durability under formate flow remains a sensitivity.

pricing.note: Annual average LME cash tin price 2024, $14.0/lb (USGS MCS 2025). Replaces a live-feed reference to a symbol the price service does not carry. Former live-feed precursor markup (1.10) folded out; the public quote stands alone.

candidates.title: Ag CO-selective MEA cathode
candidates.summary: Silver gas-diffusion cathodes in imidazolium-membrane MEAs hold ~95% CO selectivity for months at industrially relevant current - the scale-up metal of record for CO, between costly gold and multicarbon copper.
decision_notes: The demonstrated-durability CO option: silver at roughly one-eightieth of gold's price with six-month continuous operation on record.
The Sustainion membrane term is part of the electrode stack, priced by the calculator's membrane row rather than this component list.

pricing.note: Silver nanopowder cathode on a contained-metal basis with an ink-route markup.
